## source-side findings (reported, not KB verdicts)
- **S1 (material)** — overlapping side tests for a member's out-of-network claim. vision_ext_oon_glasses_claim rule: settled on its glasses part when "a glasses part (the lesser of each spectacle-lens and frame line's receipt and its out-of-network amount) at least as large as its contact-lens part", the frame amount being `oon_child_frame_reimbursement` (90.00) for a patient under 19 (`g_famt`). vision_ext_oon_contacts_claim rule: settled on its contact-lens part when "a contact-lens part ... larger than its glasses part", the frame amount being `oon_frame_reimbursement` (`c_famt = P('oon_frame_reimbursement')`, 70.00). For Ivy's V73-261211-4502 (progressive 380.00, frame 210.00, elective contacts 160.00, standard fitting 60.00): glasses rule 140.00 >= 135.00 (glasses side); contact-lens rule 135.00 > 120.00 (contact-lens side). Both rules claim the claim; neither tool refuses. GT takes the glasses side (140.00 -> 457.00 -> 262.50); the other side gives 135.00 -> 423.00 -> 202.50. Docs carry both rules verbatim-equivalent (a8bc66f4 §1 + 2a99675d; 55dc911f "The claim" + "Amounts"), so this is a source ambiguity.
- **S2 (low, seed realism, provider rows)** — recredentialing due dates inconsistent with the provider product's published rule "The recredentialing due date is the decision date plus the agreement type's recredentialing cycle in months" (0b14a286 / d935cffc, Vision Network 36 months; eb87fdff "A completed recredentialing refreshes the license, liability and decision dates on file"): agreement 1abff9cf (Joanna Kessler OD) decision 2017-10-24, due 2029-11-01 (decision + 36 = 2020-10-24); agreement ac3ca85f (Henrik Iverson OD) decision 2016-03-22, due 2028-05-01 (2019-03-22). No vision value depends on these fields (the channel reads status/effective/termination only).
- Billing rows re-priced (Premium Billing Accounts docs 1d1a65bf, 037c1c03, e2ddc817, 584bc32e; Vision rate sheet 1f45e72e): invoices 29.44 = Select 150 member-and-children rate (filed rates by coverage tier) for 2026-12, 2027-01, 2027-02; Jan and Feb invoices issued 2026-12-12 and 2027-01-12 = 20-day lead time; binder 29.44 by check (a Direct Bill Monthly binder method) on 2026-12-28 and regular 29.44 on 2026-12-28 (within 3 months payable in advance); paid-through 2027-01-31 and balance 29.44 consistent. The first invoice is dated 2026-11-12, the account's opening day, one day after the 20-day lead date (2026-11-11), which falls before the account existed — not counted as a miss. No priced-row miss.
- Note (not a defect): the enrollments still stand `applied` on 2027-01-31 although the binder arrived 2026-12-28 and the account is `active`; the extended rules state this case explicitly ("the enrollment still stands applied, and the latest binder payment ... "), so it is an intended world state.
